title: Nanak Chinta Mat Karo
theme: A shabad for worry, anxiety and trusting that you will be provided for
intention: Sing this when worry about money, work or what comes next will not let you rest. The One who feeds creatures in the depths of the sea, where no one buys, sells or farms, is already taking care of you.

verses.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥
verses.h: नानक चिंता मति करहु चिंता तिस ही हेइ ॥
verses.t: Naanak chintaa mat karahu chintaa tis hee hei.
verses.e: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you.

verses.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.h: जल महि जंत उपाइअनु तिना भि रोजी देइ ॥
verses.t: Jal meh jant upaian tinaa bh rojee dhei.
verses.e: He created the creatures in water, and He gives them their nourishment.

verses.g: ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.h: ओथै हटु न चलई ना को किरस करेइ ॥
verses.t: Othai hat na chaliee naa ko kiras karei.
verses.e: There are no stores open there, and no one farms there.

verses.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.h: सउदा मूलि न होवई ना को लए न देइ ॥
verses.t: Saudhaa mool na hoviee naa ko le na dhei.
verses.e: No business is ever transacted there, and no one buys or sells.

verses.g: ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਖਾਣਾ ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.h: जीआ का आहारु जीअ खाणा एहु करेइ ॥
verses.t: Jeeaa kaa aahaar jeea khaanaa eh karei.
verses.e: Animals eat other animals; this is what the Lord has given them as food.

verses.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਾਇਰਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.h: विचि उपाए साइरा तिना भि सार करेइ ॥
verses.t: Vich upaae sairaa tinaa bh saar karei.
verses.e: He created them in the oceans, and He provides for them as well.

verses.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.h: नानक चिंता मत करहु चिंता तिस ही हेइ ॥१॥
verses.t: Naanak chintaa mat karahu chintaa tis hee hei. ||1||
verses.e: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you. ||1||
